scope: Clarification of the literal chronology in the preserved protocol; no experiment outputs changed
protocol_statement: leave_teacher_out.radar_model describes archived BearLLM students trained before RotLLM was acquired
actual_execution: The stitching experiment consumes the 36 rerun students saved in controls/results/windows. Three baseline methods reproduce earlier stage_b_v0 archived metrics exactly; artificial-code and wrong-class controls are newly trained in this iteration.
valid_independence_statement: No RotLLM features, head, scores, or labels are used by run_controls.py to fit the radar students or construct their targets. The radar students are frozen before contact-only mapping and evaluation.
not_claimed: All current student checkpoint files predate retrieval of the RotLLM model; blind evaluation on new recordings; universal teacher transfer
